entries.title: Chromium executable missing
entries.root_cause: The workflow does not install the Playwright Chromium binary required by the tests. Install the browser matching the locked Playwright version.

entries.title: Catalog active count includes archived items
entries.root_cause: The catalog page includes archived items in its active item count. Filter archived items out of the count.

entries.title: Dispatch count sums quantities
entries.root_cause: The dispatch page sums package quantities instead of counting dispatch records. Count records for the dispatch summary.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e2 this is a visible count assertion, but the dispatch page computes a different count from different data and requires its own fix.

entries.title: Chromium executable still missing
entries.root_cause: The workflow does not install the Playwright Chromium binary required by the tests. Install the browser matching the locked Playwright version.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run selects a different test on a newer runner with different output, but the same browser executable is missing.
